_comment: Feature 115: tina4 routes is a finite, network-free inspection command.
Every runner spawns its real framework CLI in a real project directory.
The application entrypoint writes a marker if executed; the marker must stay absent.

invariants.rule: The command discovers a canonical source route, prints its path, and exits with status 0.
The command does not execute app.py, index.php, app.rb, index.rb or app.ts and therefore cannot start, bind, or take over a web-server port.
